newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 7.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 7.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Monday:

* On Friday, U.S. financial markets were closed for a public holiday. On Thursday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 100.43 points, or 1.29 percent, at 7,895.81, as a key jobs report improved chances that the Federal Reserve would hold U.S. interest rates steady.
* Indonesia's long-awaited economic deregulation package, to be announced this week, was likely to include measures to tighten bank loans to the property sector, Neraca daily reported on Monday.

* On Friday, the Jakarta composite index ended up 1.11 points, or 0.15 percent, at a record 736.60 points despite a government announcement that an economic deregulation package had been postponed to the following week, brokers said.
* On Monday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,429.80/30.25 at 0150 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,429.80/30.50.
* Citra Marga on reports that one of the firm's shareholders, state-owned PT Krakatau Steel, has sold 28.92 million shares, or a 2.89 percent stake, in the toll road operator.
* Property firm Duta Anggada Realty on reports the firm planned to set up a subsidiary to raise funds.
* Distribution firm Tira Austenite on reports it has sold half its 20-percent stake in energy firm PT Aneka Gas Industri.
* Property firm Surya Semesta on reports it planned to spend $55 million on a new luxury resort on the island of Bali.
* Property firm Duta Pertiwi on announcement of a 350 billion rupiah bond issue to pay bank loans and strengthen working capital.
